department: Korteweg-de Vries Institute for Mathematics (KdVI), Faculty of Science

deadline.value: Positions are advertised at any time with tight deadlines; no unsolicited applications.
deadline.quote: Positions may be advertised at any time (there is no particular time of the year for applications)

supervisor.value: Each advertised job comes with a fixed project topic and supervisor.
supervisor.quote: Normally, these jobs come with a precise job description which will determine your PhD thesis topic and supervisor.

funding.value: Hired PhD students are salaried UvA employees who pay no tuition fee; non-employed routes also exist.
funding.quote: PhD students hired as an employee will not have student status, but will be full time employees of the Universiteit van Amsterdam. | They do not pay a tuition fee.

entry_route.value: A degree equivalent to a Dutch Master's and research experience are required.
entry_route.quote: In order to be a PhD student in the Netherlands, you need a degree equivalent to a Dutch Master's degree. | We only hire PhD students with research experience.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: KdVI page lists a salary range that looks outdated, so it is not used. Non-EU applicants need a work permit.
